description: This file defines the DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor class, which handles duplication of investments with customizable limits and rules within the Goteo project, including methods for calculating amounts based on rewards, project limits, and user constraints.

classes.name: DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes duplication of investments with customizable limits and rules, extending AbstractMatcherProcessor.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for the configurable variables used in the processor.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a description of the matcher rules.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Calculates the amount to be invested, considering rewards and limits.

methods.name: getAmountMatchingRewards
methods.description: Calculates amount based on matching rewards, or returns 0 if no rewards match.

methods.name: getRegularAmount
methods.description: Calculates the standard investment amount considering project and user limits.
